nodes.label: CLAUDE.md: Project Instructions
nodes.rationale: Central project instructions documenting GLUE's architecture, code organization, tooling, and workflows

nodes.label: GLUE: Local-First DJ Music Manager
nodes.rationale: Web app for DJs: builds music collections from folders and DJ-app libraries (Rekordbox, Engine DJ, Traktor, Apple Music), analyses quality/BPM/key, manages playlists and duplicates, exports back to DJ apps

nodes.label: Speklone: Spectral Forensics Heritage
nodes.rationale: Original spectral forensics tool ('is this hi-res actually hi-res?'); became GLUE's per-track Inspector and Analyze a file mode

nodes.label: GLUE Home: Local Tauri App
nodes.rationale: Tauri 2 tray app on Windows and macOS; serves as library engine and website screen when running (ADR 0104); provides local link (127.0.0.1:47400-47409), analysis queue, file I/O, and WebRTC streaming

nodes.label: GLUE Cloud: Account and Sync
nodes.rationale: Optional Cloudflare Worker with D1 and Durable Object; holds account's collections (never music), profiles and devices; optional for syncing across devices

nodes.label: ADR 0002: No Server Sees Your Music
nodes.rationale: Website works standalone, accounts optional, audio only between user's computers

nodes.label: ADR 0007: OS Access via Platform Layer
nodes.rationale: All OS access only through src/platform/; browser handles or GLUE Home's disk in Home mode

nodes.label: ADR 0009: JSON Files, No Database
nodes.rationale: GLUE's data is JSON files in user's GLUE folder, not a database

nodes.label: ADR 0010: Never Write into DJ Apps in v1
nodes.rationale: Never write into another app's library during v1

nodes.label: ADR 0044: GLUE Home is Tauri 2
nodes.rationale: Desktop tray app built with Tauri 2 framework

nodes.label: ADR 0051: GLUE Home as Disk and Engine
nodes.rationale: When GLUE Home runs, website uses it as disk and engine via local link; one writer at a time (tab holds lease or GLUE Home writes)

nodes.label: ADR 0126: Gluey - Help and Tours
nodes.rationale: When feature changes, update help article (src/help/*.md) and tour (src/core/guide/tours.ts with data-guide attributes); tests verify existence

nodes.label: ADR 0127: Graphify Code Map
nodes.rationale: Code map via graphify-out/graph.json (tree-sitter) mapping code symbols and vault docs; order: vault first, graphify to find files, source last

nodes.label: ADR 0129: Extract Docs for Graphify
nodes.rationale: When docs change, refresh graph via scripts/graph_docs.py before commit; subagents per batch

nodes.label: Gluey Tours: Interactive Guides
nodes.rationale: Data-driven tours in src/core/guide/tours.ts pointing at data-guide UI attributes; shown per person per profile

nodes.label: Crate glue-audio: Native Analysis Engine
nodes.rationale: Rust port of src/core analysis with JavaScript numbers; line-for-line equivalent held by tests/golden

nodes.label: Crate glue-store: Library Store in Rust
nodes.rationale: Rust library store held byte-for-byte to src/store/collection.ts by tests/golden/store

nodes.label: Crate glue-engine: Home Library Engine
nodes.rationale: GLUE Home's library engine: local link /rpc, stores, jobs, repair, analysis queue; one per collection; applies tab edits, saves, feeds changes back

nodes.label: Crate glue-rtc: WebRTC Connections
nodes.rationale: GLUE Home's peer connections to other devices; webrtc-rs speaking website's protocol (src/core/transfer.ts)

nodes.label: DJ Library Interoperability
nodes.rationale: Imports from Rekordbox, Engine DJ, Traktor, Apple Music; exports back to Rekordbox and Engine DJ; parsers in src/core/interop/
